coverage.why: All seven accounting areas plus industry_lens and every financial section (DuPont and path to distress included) carry a reading, and input_manifest analysis_stages records no drops; but cost_deferral says no cost is visibly capitalised although notes:94 and notes:96 show capitalised software and stock-based pay.

calibration.why: Each area verdict restates the anomalies filed under it; for example, estimates_and_reserves pairs its thinner allowance and income-raising judgments with the bad-debt, reserve, founder-share and recovery anomalies, and cross_document_reconciliation's verdict matches its prose-against-prose items.

valuation_reading.why: In the calculator, market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing leave no price and no implied growth, and valuation.missing means no sensitivity was run; the reading says so and offers operating_margin_year_ten and revenue_growth_year_one as least-grounded drivers, not measured sensitivities.
